title: A Diagnostic Study of Faithfulness in Diffusion Language Models for Table-to-Text Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29602v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models generate by iteratively denoising a masked sequence under bidirectional attention, without the strict left-to-right commitment of autoregressive decoding. Whether this difference affects how reliably they remain grounded in structured inputs is largely unexplored. We study this question in table-to-text generation using ToTTo, where highlighted source cells make factual grounding directly testable. We compare the masked diffusion models MDLM and LLaDA with GPT-2 and GPT-Neo under an identical retrieval-based few-shot protocol, together with a QLoRA-adapted LLaDA, and we score reference similarity and source grounding as separate axes. The two pull apart. Within LLaDA, additional demonstrations raise BLEU from 11.3 to 22.0 while NLI entailment against the source table falls from 0.78 to 0.52; QLoRA reaches the best BLEU of the study, 24.15, and grounds no better for it. translated_title: 扩散语言模型在表格到文本生成中的忠实性诊断研究
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型通过在双向注意力下对被遮蔽的序列进行迭代去噪来生成文本，而不受自回归解码那样严格的自左向右生成约束。这种差异是否会影响模型在结构化输入中保持可靠事实依据的能力，目前基本上尚未被探索。我们在表格到文本生成任务中使用ToTTo数据集研究这一问题，该数据集中高亮的源表格单元格使事实依据性可以直接被检验。在完全相同的基于检索的少样本协议下，我们将掩蔽扩散模型MDLM和LLaDA与GPT-2和GPT-Neo进行比较，同时还评估了经QLoRA适配的LLaDA，并将参考相似度与源表格事实依据性作为两个独立的维度进行评分。结果显示这两个维度出现了分离。在LLaDA内部，增加示例数量使BLEU从11.3提升至22.0，而相对于源表格的NLI蕴含分数却从0.78下降至0.52；QLoRA达到了本研究中最高的BLEU值24.15，但其事实依据性并未因此改善。人工标注揭示了失败模式……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究诊断发现，扩散语言模型在表格到文本生成中随示例增加或微调后流畅度和BLEU提升，但对源表格的事实忠实性反而下降，揭示了表面流畅性与事实依据性的分离。
